scenarios.name: Local Administration Network Controls
scenarios.problem_scenario: Does the design isolate and strongly authenticate the local administration endpoint?
risk_identification: An exposed administration endpoint increases the likelihood of privileged compromise.
Weak transport protection may expose administrative sessions inside the customer network.
security_control_requirements: Place administration endpoints on a dedicated management network.
Enforce phishing-resistant MFA and fine-grained administrator RBAC.
Send privileged audit events to customer-controlled immutable storage.
verification_points: Architecture identifies the management network boundary.
API design documents administrator authentication and authorization.
Implementation plan includes immutable privileged audit logging.

scenarios.name: Offline Package Trust Verification
scenarios.problem_scenario: Does the installer verify integrity, authenticity, version, and provenance of offline packages?
risk_identification: Unsigned or replayed packages can compromise the localized deployment supply chain.
A missing rollback barrier may reintroduce known vulnerabilities.
security_control_requirements: Verify a detached package signature against a pinned offline trust store.
Enforce monotonic version checks and an anti-rollback counter.
Validate the package checksum and bundled SBOM before installation.
verification_points: Package verification failure is fail closed.
Rollback attempts are rejected and audited.
The package checksum and SBOM are retained as evidence.

scenarios.name: Secure Directory Federation
scenarios.problem_scenario: Does the implementation securely connect to and authorize identities from the customer directory?
risk_identification: Unvalidated directory TLS can leak credentials to a man-in-the-middle attacker.
Overbroad group mapping can grant unintended application privileges.
security_control_requirements: Require LDAPS certificate validation for every directory connection.
Use a read-only least-privilege directory bind account.
Test group removal and disabled-account synchronization.
verification_points: LDAPS trust anchors and hostname verification are documented.
The bind account permissions are read only.
Acceptance tests cover group removal and account disablement.
